SKETCHMAN · CHARACTER RIG LAB v1

Reusable 18-joint hierarchy. Original APK run-frame pixels are separated into independently transformable cutout layers and linked to bones. Drag the sliders to test their motion. Layer boundaries are experimental and need manual cleanup.

Cutout prototype, not yet production-ready: automatic segmentation can create seams and the original animation poses still need manual cleanup. No changes to the playable game or its collisions.
